frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living bone-crushing dog with short domed skull, deep jaws and heavy forequarters.

scientific_limits.en: Original genus-level living reconstruction, not a fossil scan. F:AM61640 B.secundus supplies real cranial anatomy; published artist reconstruction supplies a comparative body silhouette, not complete fossil evidence. Fleshed length, shoulder height, ears, fur and color are inferred. B.parvus body-mass estimates from other specimens must not be described as measurements of F:AM61640.
scientific_limits.zh: 原属级完整活体复原，并非化石扫描。F:AM61640 B.secundus 为真实颅骨依据；论文作者复原只支持身体比较轮廓，不表示完整骨架实证。活体长、肩高、耳形、毛与颜色为推断；其他标本B.parvus体重估值不得称为该颅实测。

scale.skull_reference_status: Approximate image estimate: side panel A spans about 6.9 times its 3cm scale bar. Not published caliper measurement.
scale.body_scale_status: Model proportional estimates, not specimen measurement. NPS small-wolf comparison and published reconstruction guide size; no exact live body dimensions established.

diagnostic_targets: Strongly vaulted forehead steps down onto shortened broad muzzle; not long narrow modern wolf snout.
Deep robust lower jaw and wide cheek/zygomatic mass; small ears remain distinct above head.
Broad muscular neck and forequarters, deep front chest tapering toward abdomen; not skinny fox or rectangular bear.
Canid digitigrade legs with visible elbow/hock transitions and four weight-bearing toes, small fore dewclaw optional as inference; no hooves or feline retractile claws.
Long moderate tapered furry tail; no hyena extreme spine slope, huge mane or obligatory spots.
Closed or minimally parted mouth; if teeth exposed, no saber fangs, large posterior crushing teeth rather than identical pickets.

reference_credits.title: First bone-cracking dog coprolites provide new insight into bone consumption in Borophagus and their unique ecological niche
